$comment: What the daily report monitors. `orgs` auto-expands to every non-archived repo in each GitHub org (the main knob — the apps live in orgs). `repos` adds individual repos on top. `gh` must be authenticated with access to each (private repos need `repo` scope; org listing needs `read:org`; Dependabot alerts need `security_events`). Thresholds tune what counts as an action item.
